answer: The tundra forge whisper binds one identity to one forged chime: the claimant forges a chime on the tundra, tunes it to one note, and hangs it at a pass. Three unrelated travelers each strike the chime and log the tone, whispering it onward. Two forge masters compare the three logs against the chime's stamp in the forge register within six days. A mismatched tone, a twice-forged chime, or a log signed by the same hand voids the season, burns a 150-credit stake, and bars the sponsor for two years. One honest chime costs 150 credits; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 chimes heard by three strangers each.
